title: Staff screen choices
decision: Sellers see the catalog read-only and no review queue; managers see shop settings read-only; a seller who is not the author is refused by the server when adding goods; quantity arithmetic is done on integers of thousandths with halves rounded up; the amount field accepts an amount only; a payment above the shown balance is not blocked in the browser because the shown balance may be stale; errors are shown without a new colour so that Telegram themes keep their contrast
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull requests 17 and 23
rationale: Each follows the role table of the specification or avoids showing a number the server would not accept
